title: Exercising Market Power Without Using Prices: Service Time in Online Grocery
eligible_reason: Staggered binary treatment: entry of a rival online grocer into a local market at market-specific months (approx. 26 distinct first-entry months among ~139 treated markets in the raw data, before the authors' sample trimming), never-entered control markets present, outcome is the incumbent's (Shufersal) delivery service time. Table 2 odd columns are static TWFE (market + month FE, no controls, one anticipation bin) and Figures 5-6 are unstacked event studies with market + month FE and no controls.
design_notes: Incumbent online grocer's service time (hours to earliest delivery slot) in 172 Israeli local markets, Aug 2016-Jul 2019, twice-weekly crawls aggregated to market-month. Treatment = first entry by any of four rival online grocers (entry detected as >=4 inactive months followed by >=4 active months, Define_entry_exit_dummies.do). Treated markets split by pre-entry competition level (monopoly / duopoly / competitive) and compared with control markets of matching size. Treatment is absorbing (first entry); later entries and exits enter only as controls in the even columns. Markets with multiple entries/exits (excluding Mega) are dropped; controls with exits are dropped; markets with entry in the first 3 sample months dropped.
estimators_reported: twfe_static_binned (Table 2 odd cols, Table 2 even cols/Tables 3-4 with controls)

specs.outcome_description: log of Shufersal's hours to earliest delivery slot, Saturday crawl (low-demand day)
specs.treatment_definition: post_treat = (evt_time>=0 & evt_time!=.), evt_time = crawl_month - Ei, Ei = month of first entry of a rival online grocer (Mega, Rami Levy, Victory or Yeinot Bitan) into market id; pre_treat = 1 for treated markets at evt_time in {-2,-1} (Tables.do lines 66-77); omitted category = evt_time<=-3 and never-entered markets
specs.sample_condition: sample_A==1: treated markets that were monopolies before entry (mono==1) plus all never-entered control markets (control==1)
specs.static_or_event: static with one pre-period bin (binned event study: bins (-2,-1) and (>=0), omitted <=-3)
specs.reported_location: Table 2, sample A block, column 1 (odd columns = no controls)
specs.data_file: Data/data_for_regressions.dta (constructed by Define_entry_exit_dummies.do then Data_Construction.do from the shipped raw .dta files)

ineligible_specs_summary: Table 2 even columns, Table 3 (same_day_S, same_day_W, p_before_saturday) and Table 4 (Rami Levy/Victory entries only): all include time-varying controls (store_dis_10, i_exit, entry_new), fulfilment-centre-specific linear trends and crawl_month#Q_growth FE where Q_growth is a time-varying population-growth quartile -> excluded.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Approximate: computed from Delivery_db.dta with a simplified version of the authors' entry rule (4 inactive then 4 active months), restricted to entries in months 680-714: 139 treated markets, 26 distinct first-entry months (largest cohorts: month 695 with 23 markets, 696 with 15, 688 with 15). Exact count requires running the two data-construction do-files.
modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags show the paper mentions Callaway, Borusyak, Sun-Abraham, de Chaisemartin and Goodman-Bacon, but no modern estimator appears in the replication code; any such check must be text-only or in an online appendix not in the package.
data_files_note: Raw inputs shipped as Stata .dta: Delivery_db.dta (crawler slots, 168,162 rows, 233 markets, months 677-719), Shufersal_Distance.dta, Rivals_Distance.dta, Distance_to_Rivals.dta, Pop_growth.dta, Basket_price.dta, Basket_Shufersal_Sunday_Thursday.dta. The analysis file data_for_regressions.dta is NOT shipped; it is produced by running Define_entry_exit_dummies.do then Data_Construction.do (fast, no external data).
screener_notes: No article text available; screened from code. Table/column mapping inferred from esttab order: for each sample block the four columns are S-odd, S-even, W-odd, W-even. The static spec includes an anticipation bin pre_treat for evt_time in {-2,-1}; the post_treat coefficient is relative to evt_time<=-3. Treat as binned event study (bins: -2/-1, >=0) when constructing CSA/BJS counterparts, or drop the two anticipation periods. The abstract reports 172 markets.
